{{Quote|Vulk died eight years ago in a Cloud Chaser crash a thousand kilometers from here. But I guess you're so parochial you won’t have heard about that. He'd already killed fourteen Xang terrorists by then, and he was mortally wounded.|[[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]], to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorus]]|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
The '''Xang''' were a group that existed in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. In [[25,801 BBY]], [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Vulk]] was [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] a [[Cloud Chaser]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]] when he was shot down during a firefight with Xang [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]]. Realizing he was doomed, Vulk piloted his ship into the [[Southern Ocean (Kalimahr)|Southern Ocean]] of the planet in order to avoid causalities in the nearby [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rhol Yan]]. Before the crash, Vulk had managed to neutralize fourteen of the terrorists.<ref name="Into the Void" />
